title: Surface tag policy load failures in diagnostics and governance UI
description:
Problem: TagPolicyService currently returns TagPolicy.CreateDefault() when Data/Policies/tag-policy.json is missing, unreadable, or invalid JSON. That fallback is useful for first-run resilience, but parse/read failures are silent, so a broken governance policy can look like a deliberate default policy.

Desired outcome: operators and agents can tell when MemorySmith is using fallback tag policy because the configured file is missing or malformed.

Scope:
- In scope: preserve safe fallback behavior, capture the policy path and failure reason without leaking sensitive paths beyond existing diagnostics posture, surface status through operational diagnostics and /tags policy diagnostics, and add regression coverage for invalid policy JSON.
- Out of scope: changing the tag policy schema or blocking all startup when the policy file is absent.

Acceptance criteria:
- Invalid tag-policy JSON produces an explicit diagnostic or health warning rather than silently behaving like defaults.
- /tags or governance API consumers can distinguish loaded-from-file from fallback-default policy.
- Operational diagnostics include a redacted/appropriate policy-load status.
- Tests cover valid policy load, missing policy fallback, and malformed policy warning behavior.

Validation:
- Add focused tests around TagPolicyService and MemoryDiagnosticsService.
- Run dotnet test MemorySmith.Tests/MemorySmith.Tests.csproj --filter FullyQualifiedName~MemoryDiagnosticsTests.
- Run ./Scripts/Test-TaskRecords.ps1 after task metadata changes.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created during 2026-05-25 deepdive audit. Evidence: MemorySmith.App/Services/MemoryGovernanceServices.cs TagPolicyService.LoadPolicy returns TagPolicy.CreateDefault() for missing files, null deserialization, and all caught exceptions; MemorySmith.Tests/MemoryDiagnosticsTests.cs covers duplicate namespaces and caching but not malformed policy surfacing.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Implemented cached TagPolicyLoadStatus so missing, loaded, empty, and failed policy reads are distinguishable while preserving fallback defaults. /tags now shows policy source/status and includes policy-load diagnostics; operational diagnostics include tag policy status and warn for malformed/unreadable policy files; /health displays the active tag policy status/path. Focused regression coverage verifies missing fallback info, malformed JSON warning fallback, valid loaded policy status, and cache status updates. Validation: dotnet build .\MemorySmith.App\MemorySmith.App.csproj --nologo passed; MemoryDiagnosticsTests passed 10/10 via focused test runner.
